## Recall · Files and AI

a) Which file name is best for the price list of 3 November 2026?
b) Which three parts does a clear prompt have?
c) The AI's notice adds a fact that is not true. What do you do?

::: {.answer}
a) 2026-11-03_price-list.xlsx
b) a task, a context and a format
c) Correct it before you send it.
:::

## Recall · Word

a) Which paste option takes only the words from an AI chat?
b) What makes clear headings that a table of contents can use?
c) Nobody may change the notice that you send. Which format do you use?

::: {.answer}
a) Keep Text Only
b) the styles Title, Heading 1 and Heading 2
c) PDF
:::

## Recall · Excel

a) C2 has =B2\*\$F\$1. You copy it to C3. Which formula is in C3?
b) What is the price with tax of a bag of 12 JD, with a tax of 10 %?
c) Which chart shows how the sales change from Sunday to Thursday?

::: {.answer}
a) =B3\*\$F\$1
b) 13.2 JD
c) a line chart
:::

## Summary

- A clear prompt has a task, a context and a format, and you check every AI fact.
- Keep Text Only, the style Title and a PDF copy make a clean notice.
- A good file name starts with the date.
- A formula with \$F\$1 can be copied down, and SUM adds the range.
- Sort, a colour rule and a chart answer questions about the data.
